title: 第十三章 洪荒异种的特殊 至阳之毒第十四章 丹成九转
slug: 西游从蜈蚣精到百目真君
content_zh:
吴耀一路御风疾行，回到凌虚洞时，洞口的木门虚掩着，门缝里透出暖黄色的珠光。
推门进去，一股浓烈而纯粹的药气扑面而来。
不是寻常药材熬煮时的浊气。
而是一种层次分明、清冽如酒的冷香，闻了之后浑身的毛孔都舒张开几分。
凌虚子正背对着门口站在石桌前，灰布道袍的袖子高高挽到肘弯以上，露出两条干瘦却稳当的手臂。
听到脚步声，他回过头来，瘦削的脸上带着几分疲惫，但双眼精光闪烁，精神头十足。
“道友回来得正好。”
凌虚子侧身让开，露出石桌上整整齐齐摆放着的三只玉瓶和一方玉匣。
三只玉瓶都是上好的羊脂白玉质地，瓶身半透明，隐约能看到瓶中液体的颜色和分量。
玉匣则通体墨绿，触手冰凉，匣盖紧闭，一丝气息都不曾外泄。
“幸不辱命。”
凌虚子指着石桌上的成果，语气中带着一丝自得。
“金蟾毒以文火慢熬七日，去芜存菁，得精毒三两。
巨蛇毒囊先去了鳞再取汁，滤了三遍，得精毒四两。
蝎尾毒针毒性最强，贫道单独处理，用寒玉为砧、银刀为刃，取毒针尖端的精华，得了二两。
三味毒液都已按丹方上的要求精炼完毕。”
吴耀拿起玉瓶一一查看。
金蟾毒液色如金浆，在瓶中缓缓流转，触手温热，隐约能感应到其中残存的接近地仙级威压。
蛇毒深碧如潭，稠而不凝，轻轻一晃便翻起层层墨绿色的涟漪。
蝎毒最是霸道，墨绿色的毒液被盛在玉匣之中，匣盖只开了一条缝，便有一股辛辣的腥气直冲鼻腔。

吴耀点了点头，将三瓶毒液放回原处，又从怀中取出七只水晶瓶，一字排开放在石桌上。
七色蛛毒在珠光下折射出斑斓的光芒，赤如熔岩，橙如蜜蜡，黄如琥珀，绿如翡翠，青如湖水，蓝如深海，紫如陈酿。
七色交织，与旁边三只玉瓶摆在一处。
“好纯的蛛毒。”
凌虚子凑近端详，啧啧称奇，“这七个蜘蛛精的修为虽不算高。
但本命蛛毒凝练得极为纯净，而且七色毒性各异却又同出一源。
这种材料，有钱都未必买得到。”
吴耀没有多言，将七只水晶瓶也一并放在石桌上，然后往后退了两步。
他深吸一口气，周身妖气涌动，身上那件金色法衣光芒大盛。
下一秒，他的身形在人形与妖形之间剧烈扭曲。
衣袍翻飞间整个人骤然化作了一条长达数丈的巨大蜈蚣，通体覆盖着暗金色的甲壳，每一节甲壳上都嵌着一只紧闭的金目。
百足齐齐划动，洞内的珠光被甲壳折射成无数道碎金，映得整座洞府忽明忽暗。
凌虚子虽然早就知道吴耀的根脚。
但亲眼见他现出本体，还是不由自主地屏住了呼吸。
洪荒异种的威压不是闹着玩的。
那股扑面而来的古老气息。
仿佛眼前的不是一只蜈蚣，而是一条从开天辟地之时便蛰伏在深山中的远古异兽。
吴耀稳住本体，将心神沉入丹田，催动体内妖力逼向毒腺。
百足之虫的毒腺位于颚牙根部，与他心神相连，平日里蕴养在妖力之中，毒性日积月累愈发精纯。
此刻他主动逼迫，暗金色的毒液从颚牙尖端缓缓渗出，一滴，两滴，三滴。
content_en:
Wu Yao rushed against the wind all the way, and when he returned to Lingxu Cave, the wooden door at the entrance of the cave was ajar, and warm yellow pearlescent light shone through the cracks in the door.
When he pushed the door open and walked in, a strong and pure medicinal gas hit his face.
It's not the turbid smell you get when ordinary medicinal materials are boiled.
It is a cold fragrance with clear layers and as clear as wine. After smelling it, the pores all over the body will relax a bit.
Ling Xuzi was standing in front of the stone table with his back to the door. The sleeves of his gray preacher's robe were rolled up above the elbows, revealing two thin but steady arms.
Hearing the footsteps, he turned around. His thin face looked a little tired, but his eyes were shining and he was full of energy.
"Fellow Taoist came back just in time."
Ling Xuzi stepped aside, revealing three jade bottles and a jade box neatly placed on the stone table.
The three jade bottles are all made of fine mutton-fat white jade. The bottles are translucent, and the color and weight of the liquid in the bottles can be vaguely seen.
The jade box was dark green all over, its tentacles were cold, and its lid was tightly closed, not a trace of breath leaking out.
"Fortunately, I did not disgrace my life."
Ling Xuzi pointed to the results on the stone table with a hint of complacency in his tone.
"The toad poison is simmered over slow fire for seven days to remove the deadwood and retain the green essence, and obtain three ounces of poisonous essence.
The scales were removed from the giant snake's venom sac before the juice was extracted. After filtering three times, four ounces of poisonous essence was obtained.
The scorpion tail poisonous needle is the most poisonous. Pindao dealt with it alone. He used cold jade as the anvil and a silver knife as the blade. He took the essence from the tip of the poisonous needle and got two taels.
The three flavors of venom have been refined according to the requirements of the elixir. "
Wu Yao picked up the jade bottle and looked at it one by one.
The golden toad venom is like golden syrup, flowing slowly in the bottle. It is warm in the tentacles, and you can vaguely feel the pressure that is close to the earthly immortal level remaining in it.
The snake venom is as deep as a pool, thick but not solid, and creates layers of dark green ripples with a slight sway.
Scorpion venom is the most overbearing. The dark green venom is contained in a jade box. The lid of the box is only opened a crack, and a pungent smell goes straight into the nose.
Wu Yao nodded, put the three bottles of venom back to their original places, took out seven crystal bottles from his arms, and placed them in a row on the stone table.
The seven-color spider venom reflects dazzling light under the pearlescent light, red like lava, orange like beeswax, yellow like amber, green like emerald, green like lake water, blue like the deep sea, and purple like aged wine.
The seven colors are intertwined and placed next to three jade bottles.
"What pure spider venom."
Ling Xuzi came closer to take a closer look and marveled, "Although the cultivation level of these seven spider spirits is not high.
But the natal spider poison is extremely pure, and the seven colors have different poisons but come from the same source.
This kind of material may not be available even if you have money. "
Without saying anything, Wu Yao placed the seven crystal bottles on the stone table and took two steps back.
He took a deep breath, the demonic energy surged around him, and the golden robe on his body shone brightly.
The next second, his figure twisted violently between human form and monster form.
As his robes fluttered, his whole body suddenly transformed into a huge centipede several feet long, its entire body covered with a dark golden carapace, with a closed golden eye embedded in each section of the carapace.
The centipedes paddled in unison, and the pearly light in the cave was refracted by the carapace into countless streaks of gold, making the whole cave flicker in brightness and darkness.
Although Ling Xuzi already knew Wu Yao's background.
But seeing him appear in person, he couldn't help but hold his breath.
The pressure of the ancient alien species is no joke.
That ancient aura that hits your face.
It was as if what he saw before him was not a centipede, but an ancient beast that had been dormant in the mountains since the beginning of time.
Wu Yao stabilized his body, sunk his mind into his Dantian, and activated the demonic power in his body to push towards the poison glands.
The venom glands of the centipede are located at the roots of the jaws and teeth, and are connected to his mind. They are usually cultivated in the demonic power, and the poison becomes more and more pure over time.
At this moment, he took the initiative to force, and dark golden venom slowly seeped out from the tips of his jaws and teeth, one drop, two drops, three drops.
